summary: LightInTheBox Holding Co., Ltd. completed a $5.49 million private placement on August 10, 2026, issuing 21,397,409 ordinary shares at $0.2566667 per share ($3.08 per ADS, each ADS representing twelve ordinary shares). Chairman and CEO Jian He participated via Conner Growth Holding Limited, investing approximately $1.09 million, increasing his beneficial ownership to ~24.1%. Proceeds are earmarked for AI-driven transformation and financial flexibility. This is not a public offering and lacks a stated premium or discount. Watch for dilution impact and insider alignment signals, though no risk-arb angle applies as this is a capital-raising, not a transaction with a premium.
